Title: First Bass Kit
Body (HTML):
Everything you need to set up for your first bass.

You want to catch bass from a pond, lake, or dock, and you don’t want to spend an hour reading advice first.

This is all the tackle you need to start. Bring your own rod and reel.

  • Baitholder hooks: Octopus-style, double-barbed circle-style, 10-pack
  • Sinkers: Bulk fishing weights, assorted, 10-pack
  • Flipping jig: 3/8 oz, painted head with eyes, 3/0 hook
  • Crankbait: Medium diving, 66mm / 14g, internal rattle, ~100mm with hook
  • Paddle tail swimbait: 8-8.9cm, paired with a 4.8g jig head
  • Wacky worm: 13.5cm / 5in, 7.5g, green pumpkin & watermelon, with a 1/0 wacky hook and O-ring
  • Chatterbait: 3/8 oz, green pumpkin & chartreuse/white
  • Urchin-style finesse bait: 17mm, green pumpkin, watermelon seed, chartreuse, with 1/16 oz and 3/32 oz nail/push weights

Title: First Catfish Kit
Body (HTML):
Everything you need to set up for your first catfish.

You want to catch catfish from a river bank, a lake at dusk, or a dock after dark. Catfish tackle is different from bass tackle.

This is all the tackle you need to start. Bring your own rod and reel.

  • Circle hooks: 5/0-7/0, assorted, 10-pack
  • Dip bait treble hooks: Bait-holder spring treble hooks, 10-pack
  • Sliding egg sinkers: 1 oz, 10-pack
  • No-roll bank sinkers: 2 oz, 10-pack
  • Barrel swivels: Heavy-duty, 10-pack
  • Fluorocarbon leader line: 30 lb test
  • Catfish stink bait: Prepared dip/paste bait
